item.title: War worsens Lebanon's economic crisis with job losses, price gouging and slow business
item.description: The latest war between Israel and Hamas, and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, have sent economic shock waves across the Mideast

item.title: Polish capital makes history with the first same-sex marriage registration
item.description: Warsaw has registered its first same-sex marriage, following court rulings requiring Poland to recognize such marriages registered abroad
